strategic_plan_metadata.title: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Education Sector Development Programme VI (ESDP VI)
strategic_plan_metadata.subtitle: Education and Training Roadmap 2030 Objectives & Strategic Implementation Matrix

overarching_goal: To sustainably establish a quality, equitable, inclusive, and technologically resilient education and training system that equips all learners with relevant knowledge, critical thinking skills, and ethical values required to propel Ethiopia into a middle-income knowledge economy by 2030.

strategic_priority_programs.strategic_focus: Eliminating learning poverty through evidence-based phonics instruction in mother tongue, competency-based textbooks, and structured continuous assessment.
strategic_priority_programs.lead_directorate: Curriculum Development Executive & Teachers Development Desk

strategic_priority_programs.strategic_focus: Expanding secondary schools to rural woredas, scaling the national school feeding initiative, and subsidizing educational inputs for pastoralist, drought-affected, and marginalized communities.
Mandatory licensing of all educators, restructuring career progression around demonstrated pedagogical competency, and upgrading primary teachers to Bachelor of Education qualifications.
strategic_priority_programs.lead_directorate: Teachers and Educational Leaders Development Desk

strategic_priority_programs.priority_title: Education in Emergencies (EiE) & Climate Resilient Reconstruction
strategic_priority_programs.strategic_focus: Rebuilding conflict-damaged schools in Tigray, Amhara, Afar, and Oromia, restoring psychosocial support, and establishing disaster-resilient water and sanitation infrastructure.
operational_interventions: Rapid rehabilitation of 4,200 conflict-affected and flood-damaged schools.
Accelerated Learning Programs (ALP) for out-of-school children.
Psychosocial trauma counseling integration in primary teacher training.

strategic_priority_programs.strategic_focus: Phased transition of public research universities to autonomous governance, rigorous execution of national exit exams, and expanding industry incubation hubs.

multilateral_development_partnerships.program_name: General Education Quality Improvement Program for Equity (GEQIP-E)
Education Cannot Wait (ECW) Multi-Year Resilience Programme
